title: Understanding & Treating Addiction | Dr. Anna Lembke
summary: Andrew Huberman interviews Stanford addiction psychiatrist Dr. Anna Lembke about the biology and psychology of addiction to drugs, food, gambling, screens and more. They discuss dopamine, the opioid crisis, and her book Dopamine Nation.
why: HN people send it to others in addiction and digital-habits threads as an expert explanation of dopamine baselines.

quote.text: Highly recommend listening to Huberman's interview of Dr. Anna Lembke
